name: observe_native_calls
description: Launch the active Mach-O as an owned process under LLDB and record each entry into caller-selected functions or Objective-C methods: thread, module, symbol, load and file address, raw argument registers, selector, receiver class and optional caller frames. Every hit auto-continues. No expression is evaluated and no other process is attached. The process is killed when max_events or duration_ms is reached; exit status, captured stdout/stderr, unresolved breakpoints and limitations are returned inline. The process runs with the current user's permissions and may change files, show UI or use the network. A hardened-runtime target needs the get-task-allow entitlement.

module.description: Image file name that defines the symbol, such as `libsystem_kernel.dylib`; omit to match every image.

name.description: Exact symbol name, such as `open`, a C++ or mangled Swift symbol, or `-[NSString length]`.

class_name.description: Implementing class; omit to match every class.

__schema11.description: Stop observing and kill the process after this many recorded entries.

__schema13.description: Integer argument registers to record per entry (arm64 has 8, x86_64 has 6).

__schema15.description: Caller frames to record per entry.

__schema6.description: Overrides on top of the environment REA runs with.

__schema9.description: Observation window; the process is killed if it is still running.

argument_registers.description: Integer argument registers to record per entry (arm64 has 8, x86_64 has 6).

backtrace_frames.description: Caller frames to record per entry.

duration_ms.description: Observation window; the process is killed if it is still running.

environment.description: Overrides on top of the environment REA runs with.

max_events.description: Stop observing and kill the process after this many recorded entries.
